rules.name: SQL Injection Attack Detected
rules.description: Detects SQL injection patterns in HTTP requests including UNION SELECT, OR 1=1, and comment-based injection
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%input-validation%' OR payload ILIKE '%sql-injection%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES
